name: Family Reunification Residence Permit

requirement_groups.name: Family member of an Albanian citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse or qualifying family member of an Albanian citizen -- initial permit is issued for 1 year, then renewable for 2-year periods.

requirement_groups.name: Family member of a foreign resident

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse or qualifying family member of a lawfully resident foreign national -- initial permit is issued for 1 year, renewable.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or proof of qualifying family relationship

outcome.duration_length: 1 year initial, then 2-year renewals (with Albanian citizen) or 1-year renewals (with foreign resident)

sources.title: Ministria e Brendshme (Ministry of Interior) -- Family Reunification category: with Albanian citizen (1-year initial, 2-year renewals) vs. with foreign family members (1-year initial, renewable); refugee family reunification gets 3-month expedited processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Albania). citizenship_after_months (12) reflects the fastest legal path available to a spouse -- the marriage-based naturalization track requires only 1 year of continuous lawful residence while married 3+ years to an Albanian (see al_citizenship_by_marriage.json) -- distinctly faster than the standard 7-year naturalization bar. The source also confirms a distinct, faster refugee-family-reunification process (3-month expedited processing for spouses/dependent children of recognized refugees) -- not modeled as a separate route here since it is a processing-speed variant of the same underlying family-reunification mechanism, tied to al_international_protection.json's outcome rather than a standalone eligibility path.
